text:
Liam (oncall): Heads up team — at 2026-05-02T16:02 UTC we're seeing customers in eu-west-1 receive responses from an older model variant (redwood-1.3) after an autoscaled rollover to redwood-2.0. Some responses show format differences; error rate low but impactful for stringify checks. Declaring incident. Severity: S3. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2210009999

model-router-bot: alert: model_variant_mismatch detected in eu-west-1 at 16:02:11 UTC (route_fallback_count=154 in 5m).

Hana: I'm pulling routing table and cache entries. Early signal: rollout completed for redwood-2.0 but a stale routing cache on the edge-router caused fallback policy to select redwood-1.3 for a subset of sticky sessions.

Sophie: We rotated weights at 15:50 and then autoscaler drained some redwood-2.0 nodes. Fallback policy was supposed to prefer 2.0, but there was a timing window where outdated cache + sticky cookie led to 1.3. Rolling a targeted cache purge for edge-router-eu-west-1. Command: `edgectl cache purge --service=edge-router --region=eu-west-1 --pattern="route:vhost:*"`

deploy-bot: cache purge executed at 16:05:02 UTC  status: success.

Telemetry: After purge, route_fallback_count dropped from 154 -> 8 over 3m. Note: template-version-mismatch metric shows 0.6% customer-visible schema diffs remaining. Query: `increase(route_fallback_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])`

Elliot: Can we identify affected tenants? Telemetry: give list of top 10 tenant ids by fallback rate so CS can notify.

Telemetry: Pushing top tenants to incident doc: tenant_203, tenant_412, tenant_77. Also linking a small sample of mismatched responses for verification.

CS: Draft customer message: "We briefly served older model variants to a subset of sessions in eu-west-1 during a rollout window. We rolled back routing cache and fixed the issue; no data exposure. We're following up with an RCA and will share per-tenant impact metrics." Will hold updates until we confirm per-tenant counts.

Hana: Root cause hypothesis: caching TTL for route lookup was inadvertently increased to 15m in the recent edge optimizations PR; when combined with autoscaler drain and immediate traffic shift, stale entries persisted. Reverting TTL to 30s as mitigation. Command: `edgectl config set route_cache_ttl=30s --region=eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: config change applied at 16:09:45 UTC  status: success.

Liam (oncall): Current status: mitigated — cache purge and TTL rollback reduced mismatches; monitoring for 30m. Incident state: mitigated. RCA owners: Hana (routing), Sophie (deploy logic), Telemetry (impact metrics).

Elliot: Follow-ups: add automated guard that invalidates route cache on model weight changes and add an alert for template-version-mismatch >0.2% sustained 3m.

Sophie: I'll own the deploy-side fix and add a small canary window after autoscaler events. Also adding preflight that triggers cache invalidation for weight rotations.

CS: Status page updated to "Operational (mitigated)" and affected tenants notified privately. Link: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2210009999

Liam (oncall): Closing thread unless recurrence. Thanks all.
